name: Madison Air
description: Madison Air designs and manufactures indoor air quality and HVAC equipment for commercial, data center, healthcare, education and residential customers, and has been listed on the NYSE since 2026.

name: Equinix
description: Equinix operates more than 240 colocation and interconnection data centers in over 70 markets worldwide, renting space, power and network links to enterprises, cloud and network providers; Nasdaq-listed.

name: Bridgit
description: Bridgit is a Sydney-based non-bank lender providing short-term bridging loans to Australian homeowners buying before they sell, mainly through mortgage brokers, backed by over A$1.7 billion of debt funding.

name: SWI Group
description: SWI Group is an alternative investment firm, combining Stoneweg and Icona Capital, that manages about EUR 11 billion for investors across real estate, data centres, credit and financial services.
note: Formed by merger of Stoneweg and Icona Capital (2025); holding company listed on Euronext Amsterdam (Feb 2026)

name: OpenAl Deployment Company
description: OpenAI Deployment Company is a majority OpenAI-owned unit that places engineers inside enterprises to build and run AI systems in production, launched in 2026 with over $4 billion in funding.

name: MasOrange
description: MasOrange is Spain's largest telecom operator by customers, selling mobile, fixed broadband and TV services to consumers and businesses, with about 26 million mobile and 7.1 million broadband customers.
note: Formed by Orange-MasMovil merger (2024); Orange acquired remaining 50% and owns 100% (June 2026)

name: FedEx
description: FedEx provides express parcel, ground delivery and logistics services to businesses and consumers in more than 220 countries and territories, with about $95 billion in annual revenue.
note: Spun off FedEx Freight as a separate company (June 2026)

name: Shuk
description: Shuk Hertzel is an Israeli fresh-produce retailer and distributor that sells to shoppers through 12 supermarket branches and supplies about 100 franchised produce departments inside other retailers nationwide.
note: Owned by Dudu Ezra Holdings; acquired Stop Market chain (Oct 2026)

name: Heidi Health
description: Heidi Health makes an AI medical scribe that transcribes consultations and drafts notes and letters for clinicians and hospitals, and is used in over one million consultations weekly.

name: NexBank
description: NexBank is a Dallas-based bank providing commercial, institutional and mortgage banking services to businesses, financial institutions and consumers, with parent NexBank Capital holding about $17 billion in assets.

name: Zurcher Kantonal Bank
description: Zürcher Kantonalbank is the Canton of Zurich's publicly owned bank, offering retail, corporate and private banking and asset management to clients in Switzerland, with about CHF 200 billion in assets.

name: Robot Era
description: Robot Era is a Beijing-based developer of humanoid robots and dexterous hands sold to logistics and industrial customers, with robots deployed in over 10 SF Express and China Post sites.

name: Jefferson Capital Systems
description: Jefferson Capital buys and collects nonperforming consumer debt originated by banks, non-bank lenders, auto finance, utility and telecom companies, earning about $488 million in annual revenue; Nasdaq-listed since 2025.

name: Cantina Labs
description: Cantina Labs is a San Francisco company building Cantina, a social app where adult consumers create AI characters, chat with them and friends, and share character-led videos.

name: Onity Group
description: Onity Group is a US non-bank mortgage servicer and originator that services home loans for investors and lends to homeowners, with operations in the US, India and the Philippines; NYSE-listed.
note: Renamed from Ocwen Financial (June 2024)

name: Millrose properties
description: Millrose Properties is a NYSE-listed land company that buys and develops residential homesites and sells them to homebuilders, mainly Lennar, through option purchase agreements that generate monthly payments.
note: Spun off from Lennar (Feb 2025)

name: Sunrise
description: Sunrise is Switzerland's second-largest telecom operator, selling mobile, broadband, TV and business connectivity services to Swiss consumers and companies, and is listed on the SIX Swiss Exchange and Nasdaq.
note: Spun off from Liberty Global and relisted on SIX (Nov 2024)

name: HR Path
description: HR Path is a Paris-based HR consultancy that implements HR information systems, runs payroll outsourcing and advises on HR transformation for more than 3,000 clients in over 20 countries.

name: Fin
description: Fin, formerly Intercom, sells an AI customer service agent and the Intercom help desk software to businesses, and says more than 30,000 companies use its products.
note: Renamed from Intercom (May 2026); one report says Salesforce agreed to acquire it (June 2026), unconfirmed

name: National Bank of Canada
description: National Bank of Canada is a Montreal-based bank offering personal, commercial, wealth and capital markets services to clients mainly in Canada, with about 30,000 employees and C$462 billion in assets.

name: Carr Properties
description: Carr Properties is a privately held REIT that develops, owns and leases office buildings to business tenants, mainly in the Washington, DC region, with about 12 office assets.
